events.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’d be happy to spread the word—when and where is it happening?
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Opal: It’s happening this Saturday at the community center on Maple Street, from 10 to 2.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let folks know! Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center on Maple Street.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up—do you want me to check if it’s still by the community center?
events.speaker: Opal
